title: The Basilisk's Lair
description: Six miners haven't come up from the Hollow Vein since caravan-master Otto Praed lost the third crew to whatever has denned in there. The Vein feeds half of Dalhurst's ore contracts, and every week it sits closed costs the Guild a shipment already sold north. Praed put up the head-money out of the Guild's own purse - it won't pay to send men down again, only to reward whoever else does.

objectives.description: Slay whatever has denned in the Hollow Vein and taken it for its own

notes: Threat: the Hollow Vein mine closed, six miners dead, a weekly shipment lost to the Merchant Guild's ledger. Giver motive: caravan-master Otto Praed pays the bounty from Guild coin because the Guild won't spend men, only gold. Refusal: the Vein stays shut and the lost shipments keep compounding.
